title: Cross-sectional rotation metrics across core (32 coins) or all-universe cohort.
description: Cross-sectional rotation metrics across core (32 coins) or all-universe cohort. Returns top-10 gainers/losers ranked by z-normalized returns, sector-level attribution (L1/DeFi/Meme/Infrastructure/Privacy/Payments/RWA/Exchange/Other), and rotation-velocity metric (mean absolute rank-change over 7d). Periods: 7d/30d/90d. Informational research data — not investment advice.
